answer: Seats are paid for in judged labour that a cluster can only produce one unit at a time. Clones sharing a funder, host or code fingerprint drain into one delta, a registry merging them into a single cluster. That cluster may submit one task per epoch to randomly drawn judges, and each accepted task mints one saffron, which is non-transferable. Seating the k-th lotus in a delta costs k saffron, so an honest lotus pays one epoch of judged work while 100 clones need 5,050 epochs. Bribed judges or clones that slip clustering in the delta defeat it.
